events.title: Second marriage
events.description: Married John Conckelyne Jr. as 'Sarah Solmon wid' (per WikiTree, citing Southold Town Records 1:464) [R4-S3]

bio: Sarah Horton married William Salmon of Southold after the death of his first wife, Katherine. When Salmon died without a will, she married John Conklin Jr. at Southold on 2 December 1657; the town records describe both marriages and so establish her maiden name as Horton. Recent research makes her a daughter of Barnabas Horton of Southold by his first wife Anne Smith, born about 1635 near Nuneaton in England, though the older Horton genealogy confused her with a younger Sarah said to have married a Joseph Conklin. She is probably John's 10th-great-grandmother.
researchNotes: Southold Town Records vol. 1 states that William Salmon 'married with Sarah Hortton' after his first wife Katherine died, and that after his intestate death John Conckelyne Jr. 'tooke to wife the said Sarah Salmon' ([R4-S1]). The town record therefore proves her maiden name Horton. Her descent from Barnabas Horton is not stated there. Horton Genealogy (1876) does not list her; it has a daughter Sarah b. c.1653 who married Joseph Conklin, apparently a garble of this Sarah's Conklin marriage ([R4-S2]). Recent research (Dinan, In Search of Barnabas Horton, cited on WikiTree) makes her Barnabas's daughter by his first wife Anne Smith, born c.1635 near Nuneaton ([R4-S3]).
